entities.name: Gaius Domitius Dexter
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Gaius Domitius Dexter was a Roman senator who was appointed consul twice: firstly as suffect consul prior to AD 183, and secondly as ordinary consul in AD 196 with Lucius Valerius Messalla Thrasea Priscus as his colleague.
